basic_info.description:
Welcome to your new home in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Outer Sunset neighborhood! This stunning 800 sq ft in-law apartment boasts a generous 1 bedroom and 1.5 baths, offering the perfect combination of comfort and convenience.

As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the warmth of freshly painted walls and the beauty of hardwood floors that run throughout the apartment. The modern kitchen features brand new flooring and a shiny new over-the-range microwave, perfect for cooking up a storm.

Enjoy the privacy of your large walk-in closet, ample storage space, and shared utilities for a hassle-free living experience. Plus, you'll have your own dedicated parking spot right outside your door, and Muni transportation is just one block away, making it easy to get around the city.

This dog-friendly in-law is located in a quiet neighborhood providing a safe and peaceful living environment. Take advantage of the beautiful San Francisco weather by spending time in the large shared backyard, perfect for hosting summer BBQs or simply relaxing outdoors while enjoying the stunning sunsets.

You'll be surrounded by endless dining options, with Damn Fine, Sunset Cantina, and Tazaki just a short walk away. Golden Gate Park, one of San Francisco's most iconic parks, is just one block away, offering plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities and exploration. And with the beach just a 20-minute walk away, you'll have plenty of opportunities to soak up the sun and enjoy the ocean breeze.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to live in this wonderful neighborhood. Schedule a viewing today and make this apartment your new home!

Key Features:

Spacious 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath in-law apartment

Generous 800 sq ft of living space

Freshly painted walls and hardwood floors

New kitchen with over-the-range microwave

Large walk-in closet and shared utilities

Dog-friendly home with private backyard

Easy transit access with N line nearby

Muni transportation just one block away

Golden Gate Park one block away

Restaurants in walking distance; Damn Fine, Sunset Cantina, & Tazaki

Beautiful sunsets

20 min walk to the beach

Schedule a viewing today!

Smoking is strictly prohibited on the premises, and dogs are allowed with prior approval. The backyard is shared among all residents, and parking is available on the driveway. Occupancy is limited to a maximum of three individuals, and subletting is strictly prohibited. Utilities such as water, electricity, and gas are split among residents based on the number of individuals living in the property.

By choosing this rental property, you acknowledge that you have read and understood restrictions and agree to abide by them throughout your stay. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask. Thank you for considering this rental property!
